description: Source code for handling TRX firmware images, including functions for fixing up headers, checking images, and manipulating MTD devices.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header CRC in a given MTD device.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Checks the validity of a TRX image against the device and header.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header CRC and length in an MTD device at a specified offset.
